extraction_sources.source_phrase: AI-first companies seeking to see, prove, and deploy AI automation at scale.

Narma is an 'Enterprise Agentic Brain' designed for AI-first companies to see, prove, and deploy AI automation at scale. The architecture has three layers. Observe (Layer 1): lightweight desktop sensors capture work patterns including application usage, activity sequences, and time allocation. Intelligence Layer (Layer 2): a 'Brain' that detects employee intent, the business value of tasks, and 'drift' where work diverges from the intended flow. Execution Layer (Layer 3): an 'Agent Factory' that automatically generates, deploys, and monitors AI agents for validated high-ROI opportunities with built-in approval gates. The system uses existing foundation models rather than building its own LLMs, focusing instead on the 'Work Graph' to reveal where resources are burned and where AI can intercept work mid-flow to provide assistance.

raw.one_liner: Narma is an "Enterprise Agentic Brain" that helps AI-first companies see, prove, and deploy AI automation at scale.
raw.thesis: Narma is an "Enterprise Agentic Brain" for AI-first companies. Its core innovation lies in a three-layered architecture—Observe, Intelligence, and Execution—that allows it to automatically identify high-ROI AI automation opportunities and deploy AI agents without human intervention in the loop. The venture targets AI-first companies struggling to measure and deploy AI automation at scale due to a lack of telemetry, unreliable ROI, and constant system/human drift. By observing work patterns, detecting intent and value, and then generating and deploying agents, Narma aims to provide "Continuous AI lift." The founder's immediate goal seems to be building out this system. Narma is currently at the idea stage, with a detailed concept but no apparent build or user traction. Narma precedes existing solutions by providing telemetry and identifying opportunities before point solutions are implemented, or it complements existing solutions by integrating with existing foundation models to deploy new agents.

core_insight.why_different: Narma focuses on a 'Work Graph' and automated agent generation/deployment, rather than building new foundation models or requiring manual intervention.
